why_ai: Paid preparers sign returns, but most returns are rule-based screen work that tax software automates.
why_clarity: Tax law defines a correct return, and thousands of near-identical returns recur every season.
why_digital: Documents in and e-filed returns out, though many clients still come in locally.

why_ai: Policy research on take-up is automatable analysis, protected by administrative data agreements.
why_clarity: Behaviour studies follow research methods, but policy effects take years to show.
why_digital: Survey and administrative data in, studies out, funded by grants rather than buyers.

why_ai: Classifying tax forms and extracting fields is a well-defined OCR and ML task.
why_clarity: Each extracted field matches the source document or not.
why_digital: Paper, photos and PDFs in, structured tax data out on screen.

why_ai: Transmission and schema validation are deterministic software; authorized transmitter status gives some protection.
why_clarity: Every return is accepted or rejected by the tax authority with a code.
why_digital: Return files in and acknowledgements out, entirely machine to machine.

why_ai: Statutory enforcement against evasion, backed by every return joined to exam outcomes.
why_clarity: Exam selection models are scored against examination and collection results.
why_digital: Return data in and scoring models out, reachable only through government procurement.

why_ai: Senior CPAs sign complex high-net-worth returns for clients who stay with a trusted preparer.
why_clarity: Basis and passive activity rules are deterministic, though nested and varied per client.
why_digital: K-1s and statements in, e-filed returns out, with relationship-driven buying.

why_ai: Residence tests, treaties and SOFA rules create complex fact patterns a signing preparer must judge.
why_clarity: Eligibility tests are deterministic, but each client's country moves differ.
why_digital: Clients are abroad by definition, so the whole engagement is remote.

why_ai: Nexus and allocation logic is deterministic state rules that software will absorb.
why_clarity: State rules define correct allocation and credits, checkable on each return.
why_digital: Wage records in and multi-state returns out, done on screen.

why_ai: Mandatory credential renewal sustains demand, though course content is easily generated by AI.
why_clarity: Exams give objective pass or fail on an annual renewal cycle.
why_digital: Online courses and exams delivered remotely to preparers.

why_ai: Underwriters carry regulated risk decisions, with proprietary claims data on wrong positions.
why_clarity: Claims show which positions were wrong, but they emerge after notices months later.
why_digital: Claim files in and pricing and reserves out, all on screen.

why_ai: Government staff hold statutory power to investigate, enjoin and penalize preparers.
why_clarity: Registration rules are defined; misconduct cases take longer to resolve.
why_digital: Registrations are online, but investigations and injunctions involve courts and government procurement.

why_ai: Identifying changes, recalculating and explaining the difference is a deterministic process software can do.
why_clarity: The amended return either reconciles to corrected data or not.
why_digital: Prior-year and corrected data in, a 1040-X out on screen.

why_ai: Adaptive fraud schemes keep judgment novel, and AI-driven identity fraud raises demand.
why_clarity: Millions of returns are scored each season, with fraud confirmed only later.
why_digital: Return and identity data in, scores out, sold mainly to government buyers.

why_ai: Bank-regulated lending is model-driven, protected by proprietary refund arrival data.
why_clarity: Each refund arrives on time, late, offset or not, within weeks.
why_digital: Return data in and advance decisions out through preparer software.

why_ai: Expense categorization and home office rules are rule-based work bank-feed software automates.
why_clarity: Schedule C rules define correct deductions across many similar gig returns.
why_digital: Bank feeds and receipts in, returns out, with local client relationships.

why_ai: Walk-in clients bring paper to a storefront, but the returns themselves are routine and automatable.
why_clarity: Standard returns repeat at high volume in a compressed season.
why_digital: Paper documents, signage and walk-in clients in strip-mall offices.

why_ai: Mixed-status families and ITIN filers trust a bilingual community preparer, though returns are routine.
why_clarity: EITC, CTC and ITIN returns follow defined rules at high volume.
why_digital: In-person community offices with paper documents and face-to-face explanations.

why_ai: Demand forecasting and staffing models are standard analytics AI tooling handles.
why_clarity: Each season's forecasts are checked against actual returns by its fixed end.
why_digital: Returns and location data in, models out, for internal buyers.

why_ai: Media bidding and lead qualification are automated ad-tech work.
why_clarity: Leads convert to filings or not within the same ten-week season.
why_digital: Media spend in and routed leads out, entirely online.

why_ai: LLMs can read tax authority and explain it, eroding editorial analysis despite brand authority.
why_clarity: Annotation follows editorial standards, but interpretive quality is hard to check.
why_digital: Statutes and rulings in, subscription content out, sold online.

why_ai: Only enrolled agents, CPAs and attorneys may represent taxpayers in adversarial IRS negotiations.
why_clarity: Agreements are accepted or not, but strategy varies and outcomes take months.
why_digital: Notices and records in, representation by phone and filings, sold nationally.

why_ai: Encoding forms and calculations is rule translation that AI coding tools increasingly perform.
why_clarity: Each calculation and schema is tested exactly against authority test cases.
why_digital: Tax law in and software logic out, built entirely in code.
